description: Use when an agent needs one answer it can act on: a verdict on any ERC20 on five chains - a machine-readable label for who can act on your balance (no-owner-powers, owner-can-intervene, owner-controls-balances, not-a-token), a headline, a plain reading and a paste-ready card, with the evidence selector by selector. Label and card come from the bytecode and live state, never from a model. A repeated requestKey is never charged twice. Research, not investment advice. $0.02 per call, paid over x402 (USDC).

requestKey.description: Optional idempotency key you choose, 8 to 128 characters of letters, digits, dot, dash, colon or underscore. Send the same key with the same input and you get your first answer back and are NOT charged again: the repeat comes back with HTTP 409, the stored answer in the body and "charged": false, because any status at or above 400 is what cancels the payment on this service. Keys are bound to the paying address and kept 24 hours. Reusing a key with a different input is rejected, also without charge.

name: evm_verdict
title: Plain-language verdict on an ERC20, with the evidence under it
